subject: VARYING clause
notes: kb/Work PB1305 (w70 V3) closes F1 + F5: cite.py --check 13.18.64.4 'the EC-REPORT-VARYING exception condition is set to exist, the execution of the INITIATE, GENERATE, or TERMINATE statement is unsuccessful' OK 5). CobolReport.VaryingInteger tests the FROM/BY value for a fraction in its own lane (fixed: unscaled % 10^scale; binary64: Math.Truncate; SDIDI: truncation vs away-from-zero landing) and raises EC-REPORT-VARYING (Table 13 Fatal) through ExceptionState.ReportVaryingError, checking flag ReportVaryingChecking gated by EcEmitter's fatal ambient gate and bound to GENERATE/TERMINATE by EcBinder's report-production names (an INITIATE presents no group, so no VARYING expression is evaluated there). Goldens: 2002 FROM 7 / 2 and 2014 STANDARD-DECIMAL BY 7 / 2 each raise; the declarative displays EC-REPORT-VARYING and RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT continues after the unsuccessful GENERATE. DETERMINATION (w70 V3): with checking OFF the counter takes the value's integer part and the statement continues - GR5 leaves the print line's content undefined (§A.2 item 63); the reading 'abandon the statement even with checking off' was not taken.
